headline: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4 world model with real-time audio
summary: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4, a world model that generates more realistic worlds, physics, humans and real-time audio, steerable with natural-language prompts and built on Gemini 3.8 Flash. Outlets differ on availability: one says it's rolling out soon to developers and subscribers, another describes a limited research preview for trusted testers.
